# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 27 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Land Supply & Major Tender Awards

- **URA launches two GLS sites at De Souza Avenue and Tanjong Rhu Close** - Both 99-year leasehold sites on the H2 2026 Confirmed List are expected to yield about 915 homes combined, with Tanjong Rhu Close attracting estimated bids of $1,450–$1,550 psf ppr. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/ura-launches-two-gls-sites-and-one-is-in-a-new-rcr-enclave/)

- **CapitaLand-led consortium wins Town Hall Link GLS site for S$1.82 billion** - URA awarded the Jurong Lake District white site to the CapitaLand-led consortium, which submitted the highest bid; the tender was awarded on 24 November 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/jld-town-hall-link-gls-white-site/)

## Resale Market Prices

- **Condo resale prices hit an all-time high in October 2026** - Prices reached a record level even as transaction volume fell 5.9% from September and 9.1% year-on-year, with new launch competition cited as a factor in the slowdown. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-prices/)

- **Median resale 3-bedroom condo now costs $2.09M — up 50% over a decade** - The 3-bedder median has risen sharply over ten years, while the 1-bedder median moved just over 2% as fewer prime-location units transacted. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/resale-3-bedder-condos-sell-median/)

## Tax & Policy Updates

- **2027 property tax rebates confirmed for HDB and private homeowners** - HDB owner-occupiers will receive a 15% rebate, while private residential owner-occupiers get a 10% rebate capped at S$100 — reduced from the previous S$500 cap. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2027-property-tax-rebate-singapore/)
